title: cacalia haenkeana
intro: Cacalia haenkeana, commonly known as the Korean Mountain Thistle or Mountain Thistle, is a type of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its potential health benefits. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of Cacalia haenkeana include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
